title: 开窗函数排名：ROW_NUMBER / RANK / DENSE_RANK
scenario: 按部门/客户分组取 Top N 或去重（如取每个客户最新一笔订单），比子查询自连接性能高一个量级。
sql:
WITH RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderID,
        OrderDate,
        Amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY CustomerID
            ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderID DESC
        ) AS rn,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY CustomerID
            ORDER BY Amount DESC
        ) AS amt_rank
    FROM dbo.FactOrders
)
SELECT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate, Amount
FROM RankedOrders
WHERE rn = 1;
pitfall: ROW_NUMBER 严格连续无并列（1,2,3）；RANK 并列跳号（1,1,3）；DENSE_RANK 并列不跳号（1,1,2）。去重务必用 ROW_NUMBER 并补上唯一键（如 OrderID）打破排序平局，避免结果抖动。

title: 偏移开窗函数：LAG / LEAD 实现零自连接同比与环比
scenario: 财务/销售按月统计环比（MoM）与同比（YoY），无需把大表自连接两次。
sql:
SELECT
    YearMonth,
    SalesAmount,
    LAG(SalesAmount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY YearMonth) AS PrevMonthSales,
    LAG(SalesAmount, 12) OVER (ORDER BY YearMonth) AS SameMonthLastYear,
    CAST(
        (SalesAmount - LAG(SalesAmount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY YearMonth)) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(LAG(SalesAmount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY YearMonth), 0)
    AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS MoM_Pct
FROM dbo.MonthlySales;
pitfall: 若月份存在断档，LAG(col, 1) 取的是“上一条记录”而非严格意义的上个月；务必先与连续日期维表 LEFT JOIN 补齐空月，并用 NULLIF(..., 0) 防止除零报错。

title: 滑动窗口聚合：SUM() OVER (ROWS BETWEEN ...)
scenario: 计算年初至今累计（YTD）、近 7 天移动平均（7-Day Rolling Avg）或留存累计。
sql:
SELECT
    OrderDate,
    DailySales,
    SUM(DailySales) OVER (
        PARTITION BY YEAR(OrderDate)
        ORDER BY OrderDate
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS YTD_Sales,
    AVG(DailySales) OVER (
        ORDER BY OrderDate
        ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS Rolling7D_Avg
FROM dbo.DailySalesSummary;
pitfall: 省略帧子句时默认是 RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW，在 SQL Server 中会触发磁盘 spool（Worktable）导致 I/O 暴涨；明确写 ROWS BETWEEN 可走内存流式聚合，性能提升 5~10 倍。

title: 递归 CTE：一键展开组织架构 / 物料清单 (BOM)
scenario: 将父子自引用表（EmployeeID -> ManagerID）展开为完整层级路径与深度，供 Power BI 权限或钻取使用。
sql:
WITH OrgTree AS (
    SELECT
        EmpID, ManagerID, EmpName,
        0 AS Level,
        CAST(EmpName AS NVARCHAR(1000)) AS FullPath
    FROM dbo.DimEmployee
    WHERE ManagerID IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        e.EmpID, e.ManagerID, e.EmpName,
        t.Level + 1,
        CAST(t.FullPath + N' > ' + e.EmpName AS NVARCHAR(1000))
    FROM dbo.DimEmployee e
    INNER JOIN OrgTree t ON e.ManagerID = t.EmpID
)
SELECT EmpID, EmpName, Level, FullPath
FROM OrgTree
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);
pitfall: 锚点与递归成员的字符串列长度/类型必须一致（用 CAST 显式对齐）；务必加 OPTION (MAXRECURSION N) 防止脏数据成环导致死循环。

title: SARGable 索引防失效：避免在 WHERE 索引列上套函数
scenario: 按年份或日期范围筛选千万级事实表时，让优化器走 Index Seek 而非全表 Index Scan。
sql:
-- ❌ 反例：对索引列套函数，导致索引完全失效（Index Scan）
SELECT OrderID, Amount
FROM dbo.FactOrders
WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2026 AND MONTH(OrderDate) = 11;

-- ✅ 正例：改写为半开区间范围查询，精准触发 Index Seek
SELECT OrderID, Amount
FROM dbo.FactOrders
WHERE OrderDate >= '2026-11-01'
  AND OrderDate <  '2026-12-01';
pitfall: 除 YEAR/MONTH 外，ISNULL(Col, 0) = 0、Col + 1 = 10、隐式类型转换（NVARCHAR 与 VARCHAR 混比）同样会破坏 SARGability，导致 CPU 和逻辑读飙升。

title: CROSS APPLY vs OUTER APPLY：行级相关子查询神器
scenario: 为每个主表客户关联“最近 3 笔订单”或复用复杂表达式，替代繁琐的多次 CTE 嵌套。
sql:
SELECT
    c.CustomerID,
    c.CustomerName,
    o.OrderID,
    o.OrderDate,
    o.Amount
FROM dbo.DimCustomer c
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (3) OrderID, OrderDate, Amount
    FROM dbo.FactOrders f
    WHERE f.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    ORDER BY f.OrderDate DESC
) o;
pitfall: CROSS APPLY 等价于 INNER JOIN（无匹配则过滤主表行），OUTER APPLY 等价于 LEFT JOIN（保留主表行并补 NULL）。大表关联时务必确保内表有 (CustomerID, OrderDate DESC) 复合索引。

title: NOT EXISTS vs NOT IN：彻底规避 NULL 导致的空结果陷阱
scenario: 筛选从未下过单的客户或对比新旧维表差异。
sql:
-- ✅ 推荐：NOT EXISTS 免疫子查询中的 NULL，且优化器走 Anti Semi Join
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName
FROM dbo.DimCustomer c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.FactOrders o
    WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
);
pitfall: 若子查询列中哪怕只有 1 条 NULL，NOT IN 会因三值逻辑（UNKNOWN）直接返回 0 行！生产环境排查差异一律优先使用 NOT EXISTS。

title: GROUPING SETS / ROLLUP：单次扫描输出多维小计与总计
scenario: 报表需要同时输出“按大区+品类明细”、“大区小计”与“全局总计”，避免写 3 段 UNION ALL 重复扫表。
sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(Region, N'总计') AS Region,
    COALESCE(Category, N'小计') AS Category,
    SUM(SalesAmount) AS TotalSales,
    GROUPING(Region) AS IsGrandTotal
FROM dbo.FactSales
GROUP BY ROLLUP (Region, Category);
pitfall: 用 GROUPING(Col) = 1 区分“聚合产生的 NULL”与“源数据本身的 NULL”，避免把空值分类误标成小计/总计。
